name: product-report
summary: A report product's specification: which report types it must produce, where their data must come from, what layout and fidelity, which channels, which rules and sign-offs, what a run must guarantee, what must stay answerable afterwards, what identifies a document, who owns what, and when a report type is ready.

changelog.note: owned_by widens the portfolio's (the base of the chain since 2026-10-07): a report type may be owned by a role or a team.
Declares its product type, report: a registry lists it as a kind of product a studio can start.
First release: the ten Gate 1 questions of a report product owner, confirmed by Chiheb Dkhil on 2026-10-06; obligations typed by what they govern, linked to the report domain; thin by decision.
